text:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU OOM on prefill path — multiple container restarts in eu-west-1-infer-03. Impacting 10% of requests to /v1/generate. Pager: P0.

alex: oncall here, looking. which pool?

marta: seeing repeated OOMs from containers handling long-context requests (>= 32k tokens). logs show prefill memory spike then SIGKILL.

alex: paste logs?

marta: ```
[2025-06-12T09:42:11Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 12345 (infer) total-vm:5000000kB, anon-rss:4600000kB
[2025-06-12T09:42:11Z] infer: runtime error: CUDA OOM during prefill (prefill_seq_len=32768)
container exited with code 137
```

sam: ack. I've seen this pattern — long prompts + prefill vectorization blows the KV cache size.

lia: current error spike: 11.8% 5xx for /v1/generate in eu-west-1, 3 nodes restarting repeatedly.

alex: immediate mitigations we can do now?

marta: short term: 1) throttle requests with context > 16k to fallback path, 2) enable per-route prefix trimming heuristic, 3) redirect heavy-context traffic to dedicated coldmodel pool (if available).

sam: I'll flip route throttling now — pushing a policy change.

sam: `POST /internal/routing/policies` payload: `{"route":"/v1/generate","max_context":16384,"fallback":"cold-quant-v1"}`

deploy-bot: Rollout started for routing-policy-reroute (rev 2025.06.12-3) — 6/6 hosts updated.

lia: seeing drop in restarts immediately on two nodes. CPU coldmodel fallback taking some traffic. error rate down to 6.5%.

alex: good. can we also reduce concurrency on the affected deployment to lower per-container memory pressure?

marta: yes — `kubectl scale deploy infer-long-ctx --replicas=1` per-node throttle isn't ideal long-term but buys time. doing now.

eng-sre: FYI cordoning the flapping node so we can cycle it safely: `kubectl cordon eu-west-1-node-03`. planning a full restart after stabilization.

sam: cordon done, scaling yields fewer restarts. visible tail latency increased for fallback clients (coldmodel), but overall success rate improving.

lia: customer impact: two high-volume tenants (AcmeAnalytics, BetaSearch) had increased latency and occasional 500s for 12 minutes. Ops tickets created (OPS-4521, OPS-4522).

alex: drafting customer update: "We experienced transient inference failures in eu-west-1 due to GPU memory exhaustion on very large context requests. We mitigated by routing large-context requests to a fallback quantized model and cycling affected hosts. No data exposure. Full postmortem to follow." thoughts?

marta: send that, add ETA for postmortem within 48 hours.

sam: I'll stay on for handoff. alex, if you need me to escalate to infra for node-level diagnostics let me know.

alex: please escalate logs and dmesg output to infra. I'm handing to sam at 10:15 UTC — summary: root cause likely prefill KV cache growth on >16k contexts combined with a scheduling change that increased batch sizes. Mitigations applied: route throttling, prefix trimming enabled, one node cordoned & restarted, reduced replicas.

sam: taking over. I'll follow up with a short runbook and add tests to catch >16k contexts in staging.

deploy-bot: Incident status: mitigated — ongoing monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to on-call (sam). Please update runbook & tag postmortem owners.

alex: adding postmortem owners: marta + sam + eng-sre. ETA draft by EOD tomorrow.

sam: noted. leaving notes in #postmortems and will schedule a 30-min scrub at 15:00 UTC. I'll also open a backlog item to add runtime guardrails for prefill memory accounting. :thumbsup:

lia: last check — 5xx down to baseline, restarts stopped. closing pager but keeping monitoring alerting at elevated sensitivity for 2 hours.

incident-bot: Pager closed (mitigated).
